No final ELF imports ns_printrrf, ns_printrr or fp_nquery. The checksum-verified Node 22.23.3 source has no calls. All native binaries are bound by exact hashes.
No final ELF imports strfmon or strfmon_l. The checksum-verified Node 22.23.3 source has no calls. All native binaries are bound by exact hashes.
